introHtml: Poly propylene is a lightweight yet durable material commonly used in disposable PPE like isolation gowns and face shields. Its fluid-resistant properties make it a practical choice for healthcare settings or industrial environments where single-use protection is prioritized. Custom imprinting on poly propylene PPE allows you to maintain brand visibility while ensuring safety compliance. Whether you need logoed gowns for a hospital or branded face shields for a construction site, this material offers cost-effective bulk solutions.
